A1.justification: Both complete 20-page PDFs describe the same VIBE research and include Appendices A–G. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v1 reports original user-study results involving 243 participants across three datasets, including performance measurements in Table 1 and additional analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains the original 243-participant user study, Table 1 results, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains identical grounding and utility scores, masked-inference procedures, and weighted summary selection. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use LearningPaper24, LongVideoBench, and SUTD-TrafficQA with identical task and scenario coverage.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Video Only and Naive comparisons. Figure 3 retains the same comparators, including author-written TL;DRs and abstracts for LearningPaper24. Appendix CoT comparisons are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The between-subjects design, stimulus counts, five-candidate selection, evaluation metrics, and model settings are unchanged. Appendix D retains identical sampling and preprocessing settings.

E4.justification: The qualitative example in Appendix A, VLM ablation in Appendix B, and correlation analyses in Section 5.3 and Appendix G are identical.

E5.justification: Both versions use identical mean-and-standard-deviation reporting, standard-error markers, independent t-tests, Cohen's d, and Spearman correlation tests. No run or seed information is added.

E6.justification: All corresponding numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged, including appendix results. For example, Table 1 reports LearningPaper24 Max-U accuracy of 37.89 ± 10.04% in both versions.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(5), information-theoretic definitions, masked-probability approximations, and associated assumptions are identical. No mathematical reasoning or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain identical claims about annotation-free, task-aware summary selection without retraining and improvements in human decision-making performance.

C2.justification: The grounding–utility trade-off, utility's requirement for task labels, limited benefits for short clips, and masking and VLM-bias limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Code and dataset access links are unchanged. Appendices C–F retain the same curation details, masking thresholds, frame sampling, participant instructions, and recruitment information.

R1.justification: Section 2, the positioning relative to prior work, and all 48 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: Page 1 changes Sandeep Chichali to Sandeep Chinchali and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. All other prose, headings, and section and appendix organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–9 and Tables 1–5 retain identical formatting, captions, and placement. Rendered pages 2–20 are identical; first-page differences are confined to author text and version/date metadata.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects an author's surname and updates version metadata. The scientific content, empirical evidence, limitations, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation remain identical, so this small editorial correction does not meaningfully alter overall paper quality.
